summary: Purchase completion is down in Germany and Sweden shortly after a storefront deployment.

sources.fact: storefront-api version 2026.34.1 reached 100 percent in Europe.
storefront-api HTTP 5xx rate remains near baseline.
payment-session success fell from 98.2 percent to 79.2 percent while provider HTTP 401 responses rose to 17.6 percent.
Purchase completion is down about 20 percent for iOS in Germany and Sweden; Android is near baseline.
